fields.v: Partly (0.5): non-parametric tests, effect sizes and multiple-comparison corrections planned and described, but not executed (protocol, no results)
fields.quote: To evaluate code quality across maintenance categories, we will employ the non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis test, followed by post-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests with HolmBonferroni correction [28]. Effect sizes will be quantified via Cliff’s Delta.
fields.why: Q8 gets full credit for analysis that is only planned, while Q5 for the same protocol is scored Partly because 'nothing measured yet'; the two are treated inconsistently.
fields.doubt: O Q8 tem Sim por testes estatísticos que ainda não foram feitos (é só protocolo), mas o Q5 tem Parcial pela mesma razão ('nada medido ainda'). Vê a pág. 5-6 e decide um critério igual para os dois: Parcial em ambos ou Sim em ambos.
